params.statement: Burp refuses a hotkey when EITHER side is taken: burp.Zfhv.ZT(III)V asserts `this.Z_.get(chord) == null` (no other action on that chord) and `this.Zp.get(actionId) == null` (that action has no chord) before it writes the two maps. A rebuild must reject both directions, not just the chord.

The hotkey settings file is authoritative, not an overlay: burp.Zfhv.Zh(Z_dk) reads it, maps the stored entries, drops later duplicates by keystroke (HashSet of ZI()), then applies them through Z_(), which first clears the whole registry via ZL(). So an action absent from the file ends up with no hotkey at all.

import zipfile, re, os, html
z = zipfile.ZipFile('/opt/BurpSuite/burpsuite.jar')
base = 'resources/Documentation/burp/documentation/desktop/tools/intruder/'
out = '/tmp/opencode/intruder'
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
def strip(h):
    h = re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?</\1>', ' ', h)
    h = re.sub(r'(?i)<br\s*/?>', '\n', h)
    h = re.sub(r'(?i)</(p|div|li|tr|h1|h2|h3|h4|dt|dd|table|ul|ol)>', '\n', h)
    h = re.sub(r'(?i)</t[dh]>', ' | ', h)
    h = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', h)
    h = html.unescape(h)
    h = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', h)
    h = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n', h)
    return h.strip()
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.startswith(base) and n.endswith('.html'):
        rel = n[len(base):].replace('/', '__')
        t = strip(z.read(n).decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
        open(os.path.join(out, rel + '.txt'), 'w').write(t)
        print(rel, len(t))

PYEOF

Each is burp.Ziog(payload, expected): a random prefix+suffix wraps the expression, and the response must contain prefix+<rendered>+suffix; the comment-split/arithmetic forms mean a literal echo can never collide (scan.rs run_ssti_check rejects a response that contains the raw payload). This replaces WebProbe's {{7*7}}/${7*7} name-only probes and merges the old separate SSTI and code-injection checks into one. Live parity: a Burp REST scan (#5) and WebProbe scanned a /tmpl endpoint that evaluates {{a*b}}/${a*b}. Suite 263/0/4.

Wave 44: SSI injection ported from burp.Zexx (echo-based), a family WebProbe lacked. Payload from burp.Zxvd.Zu: for a random token t, id1/value1 = Caesar-shift(t,14/13), id2/value2 = Caesar-shift(t,16/15) over the 36-char alphabet (burp.Zcub.Zy/Zs decoded at runtime), payload '<!--#set var="id1" value="value1"--><!--#set var="id2" value="value2"--><!--#echo var="id1"--><!--#echo var="id2"-->'. A server that processes SSI emits value1value2 contiguously (burp.Zcml.Zc); the reflected payload never shows them contiguous, so a literal echo is rejected. Issue name 'SSI injection' (Burp KB), high. Live parity: a Burp REST scan (#7) and WebProbe scanned an /ssi endpoint that processes #set/#echo. Both report SSI injection high firm on /ssi, plus Cross-site scripting (reflected) high certain and Input returned in response (reflected) info certain - identical. Suite 264/0/4. The collaborator-based SSI exec variant (nslookup, burp.Zxvd line 54) is not ported.

Issue name 'File path manipulation' high (Burp KB). Gated on a path-like value. scan.rs run_file_path_manip_check, 2 unit tests (variant templates match Zulm; a file-selector endpoint is detected, a fixed page is not). Suite 266/0/4. Not ported: Zsl1's parent-directory and sibling-file heuristics (Zp/Zs) that first locate the servable directory.

Wave 46: Link manipulation (reflected) ported from burp.Zb_5 (Zpyp), the last family that showed as Burp-only on the lab. It injects an absolute URL marker as the value (replaced then appended) and reports when the marker becomes a link or redirect target the page points at: href/src/action/formaction attribute values, or a Location/Refresh/meta-refresh/JS redirect target (reusing the open-redirect redirect_targets). Issue 'Link manipulation (reflected)' info/Firm (Burp KB). scan.rs run_link_manip_check, 4 unit tests. Suite 267/0/4.
